description:
Score current insider behavior for one company (0–100, 50 = neutral) and EXPLAIN it: open-market buying vs
selling, how unusual it is versus the company's own 5-year history, cluster buying, and C-suite participation,
with the evidence trades and SEC links. Use for 'is insider activity at X bullish or bearish?' or 'anything
unusual about insiders at X?'.
